scope: Single-pass public DXF writer test-mention index and refreshed navigation data.

validation.wholeCorpus: Original and one-pass indexer produced exactly equal JSON on the same current test-source corpus, including 114 methods and all reference lines and counts.
validation.synthetic: Separate temporary Git repository controls passed overloaded declarations, comments, multiline calls, names with shared prefixes, unreferenced and private methods, and first-line/occurrence counts.
validation.timing: One local run while a separate GUI build was active took 29.44 seconds for the original and 0.42 seconds for the single-pass indexer; timing is illustrative, not a guaranteed speedup.
validation.specializedTests: The whole-file allocation-test flag is not a coverage verdict: DATATABLE and raw-object overrides have separate allocation and rollback/retry/readback tests.

limits: Textual references are navigation only and do not prove execution, rollback, retry, readback, versions, graph closure or native semantics.
The optimization preserves the existing comment-stripping semantics rather than claiming full C++ lexical analysis.
No P6 package or phase gate is closed by this index.
